findings.rule: Following the above information, Introduction, Materials and methods (or Methods), Results, Discussion (or Results and discussion), Conclusion, Conflict of interest, Author contributions, Data availability , (A comment about deposition to a preprint server if the authors have deposited the file there: e.g. A preliminary version of this work was deposited in arXiv (ID, DOI or URL) on August 13, 2020.), Acknowledgements and References , should be arranged in this order.
findings.problem: The required 'Conclusion' section and 'Data availability' section are missing from the manuscript.

findings.rule: All tables must be cited in the text. ... Number the tables consecutively with Arabic numerals (for example “Table 3”), in the order of their appearance in the text.
findings.problem: The tables are presented at the end of the manuscript and are not in the order of their first appearance in the text (e.g., Table 1 appears before Table 2, but the text only explicitly cites Table 2).
The formatting of both Table 1 and Table 2 uses vertical lines, which is against the journal instructions.

findings.rule: References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text, tables and figure legends.
findings.problem: The references are listed in numerical order [1] through [12], but they are not ordered according to the sequence of their first appearance in the text.

findings.rule: When referring to macromolecular structures, please use [PDB ID: <PDB ID>] (https://doi.org/10.2210/pdb<PDB ID>/pdb) in the text, where <PDB ID> stands for the familiar four-character PDB accession code (e.g., 6qw9 ).
findings.problem: The manuscript refers to the structure using the format (PDB 6qw9), which does not match the required bracketed format [PDB ID: 6qw9].
